checks.detail: Fourth Round active: month 15 of 120 (Census), 7 (state data).
Latest Census data is 2 months old (normal lag is 1–3).
Latest state permit data (NJ DCA) is 10 months old (normal lag is 8–10).
564 of 564 towns matched to at least one permit source.
Towns holding 74% of the obligation have usable state permit data since July 2025, and 54% reported at least 75% of months to Census. Warns only when neither source covers 60%.
Obligated towns holding 55% of the obligation can be compared with their 2021–25 rate on at least one source (47% state, 36% Census, 28% both). Warns under 60%.
Of 71 obligated towns comparable on both sources, 37 fall in the same band, 24 are one band apart and 10 are two or more bands apart.
0 towns had negative homes permitted since July 2025 (clipped to 0).
Latest completions data (NJ DCA certificates of occupancy) is 10 months old (normal lag is 8–10). Completions are a secondary layer.
Figures are all homes permitted; neither source tags affordable units. Reviewed by hand each month (data/review_log.md).
